source.title: Neural network based formation of cognitive maps of semantic spaces and the putative emergence of abstract concepts

confidence_rationale: A computational existence-proof that the successor-representation principle attributed to place/grid cells builds a navigable latent map of an arbitrary (semantic) space, with multi-scale curvature: fine-grained maps spread items evenly while coarse-grained maps cluster them by class, and missing/novel inputs are recovered by interpolation on the map. Supports ARC-013's 'paths/structure form a latent cognitive map whose geometry carries the content' at the modelling level, but it is a toy model on 32 hand-built feature vectors, not neural data, so source_quality and transfer are modest.
failure_signatures: The map is built from 32 hand-encoded animal feature vectors with a successor-representation learner; it demonstrates that SR yields a multi-scale latent geometry, but does not show this geometry is the brain's residue substrate nor that it is separable from salience/uncertainty.

Accuracy near 30% on next-neighbour prediction (close to the stated theoretical ceiling given multiple valid successors) shows the map is approximate; the strong 95% figure is for interpolation of held-out/incomplete inputs, a different operation from residue persistence.

mapping.source_claim_statement: A neural network trained with the multi-scale successor-representation principle (proposed to underlie place and grid cell computations) forms a cognitive map of a non-spatial semantic space; the map's geometry is multi-scale (even spread when fine-grained, class-clustered when coarse-grained) and supports interpolation of novel/incomplete inputs.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports ARC-013's generalisation of the cognitive map beyond physical space to abstract latent spaces, and the idea that the map's content is its (multi-scale) geometry, consistent with REE treating residue/path structure as a reusable latent-space scaffold (ARC-004; INV-006).
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is a computational model on a small hand-built dataset, not neural evidence; it shows SR CAN produce a curved multi-scale latent map, not that the hippocampus's residue is that map or that residue is irreducible to salience+uncertainty. Weakest of the three ARC-013 entries on directness.
mapping.source_context: Feedforward/SR neural network learning a cognitive map over 32 animal species encoded as feature vectors; in-silico only.

confidence_components.notes: Peer-reviewed (Sci Rep) but a small in-silico proof-of-concept, so source_quality is mid. Mapping_fidelity moderate for the 'latent map has multi-scale geometry' reading. Transfer_risk substantial: a 32-item toy SR model -> REE residue substrate is a long inferential reach; included as corroborating mechanism, not as primary evidence.
